title: WT ZT00 Replicate 1
source_name_ch1: Liver harvested at ZT0
characteristics_ch1: strain background: C57BL/6J | genotype/variation: WT | age: 8-12 weeks | time of harvest: ZT0 | tissue: liver
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was extracted from liver with TRIzol (Invitrogen), followed by precipitation with isopropanol and ethanol. | Library construction was performed according to the Illumina TruSeq Total RNA stranded protocol.  The input quantity for total RNA was 1ug and rRNA was depleted  using ribo-zero rRNA gold removal kit (human/mouse/rat). The rRNA depleted RNA was chemically fragmented for three minutes.  First strand synthesis used random primers and reverse transcriptase to make cDNA.  After second strand synthesis the ds cDNA was cleaned using AMPure XP beads and the cDNA was end repaired and then the 3’ ends were adenylated.  Illumina barcoded adapters were ligated on the ends and the adapter ligated fragments were enriched by nine cycles of PCR. The resulting libraries were validated by qPCR and sized by Agilent Bioanalyzer DNA high sensitivity chip.  The concentrations for the libraries were normalized and then multiplexed together.  The concentration for denaturation was 2nM and the final concentration for clustering was 200pM.  The multiplexed libraries were sequenced by the Genomics High-Throughput Facility at the University of California – Irvine on six lanes using single end 100 cycles chemistry for the HiSeq 4000.   The version of HiSeq control software was HCS 3.4.0.38 with real time analysis software, RTA 2.7.7.
data_processing: Basecalling performed using RTA version 1.18.64 | Demultiplexing performed using CASAVA version 1.8.2 | Alignment to reference assembly mm10 and known splice junctions extracted from the RefSeq database performed using ELAND v2e (Illumina) | Mapping results filtering performed using in-house tools | Read counting for each gene and normalization to RPKM values performed using in-house tools | Genome_build: mm10 | Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Gene expression results (RPKM values) of the standard RNAseq analysis are reported in the Excel file RNAseq_expression_results.xlsx for all 72 replicates. Exonic and intronic expression results (RPKM values) resulting from the EISA analysis described in Gaidatzis et al., Nat. Biotech., 2015, are reported in the Excel files EISA_exonic_expression_results.xlsx and EISA_intronic_expression_results.xlsx respectively for all 72 replicates.
